object: a bedside clock with an evening-to-morning routine: each step is a way of working with its proof, and the face warms at dawn
desc: A short path through Allen Kang's work: research with real people, habit-shaping moments, design for patients and clinicians, and apps that already run.
lede: I’m Allen, a product designer in Toronto, glad to work Pacific hours. Eight years designing, from interviews and journeys to prototypes and release. I’ve designed for patients and clinicians, nonprofit teams and accountants, and I build working prototypes in code with Claude and Cursor.
caption: Pick a time of night. Each step opens the case behind it.
h1: I design the small routines people come back to.
contact: I’d like to help more people get the rest they keep putting off.
